name.description: Arm/variant name. `no_memory` and `cognee` are reserved for the control and cognee arms.

version.description: Release tag or commit of the memory system that is run.

plugin_dirs.description: Directories passed to `claude --plugin-dir`, relative to the submission folder. Empty for marketplace-installed plugins.

install.description: Script, relative to the submission folder, that installs the system on a clean Linux container.

wipe.description: Script that empties the memory store. The runner verifies emptiness via `wipe_check` when given.

wipe_check.description: Optional script that exits non-zero when the store is not empty.

wait.description: Script that blocks until post-session processing is done; non-zero on timeout.

preindex.description: Whether the system indexes the repository before issue 1 (`preindex.sh` must then exist).

receipt.description: Optional script that prints a JSON injection receipt for the last session (what was injected and why).

usage.description: Optional script that prints JSON usage records (source=server) for the memory system's own model/embedding spend since the last call.

storage.description: Where the store lives (path or service).

network.description: Every endpoint the system contacts. Empty means fully local.

llm.description: Model(s) the memory system itself calls, or provider `none`.
